## 1. Continuous Batching in LLM Inference Servers

### Concept & Mechanics
Traditional static batching processes requests in discrete, fixed-size batches (e.g., batch size 8 every 50 ms). If only 2 tokens are ready, GPU compute capacity sits idle waiting for more requests to fill the batch.

**Continuous Batching** (also known as *iterative scheduling* or *decoupled scheduling*) decouples the arrival of requests from the execution of token generation. Instead of rigid batch boundaries, the scheduler dynamically forms batches at every decoding step based on which sequences have active tokens to generate.
